expires_today.title: Kurt Busiek's Astro City: The 30th Anniversary by Image Comics
expires_today.long_description: Celebrate multi‑time Eisner and Harvey Award winner author Kurt Busiek’s most popular works with The 30th Anniversary Bundle by Image Comics! Lose yourself in the complete Astro City series! How do average people, support teams, and even villains navigate day‑to‑day life in a world where being truly super is possible—read volumes 1‑17 and see what makes Astro City so unforgettable. Or explore The Autumnlands, an epic tale that melds mature themes with high‑fantasy wizardry! Pay what you want for critically acclaimed comics and help support The BINC Foundation with your purchase!

expires_today.title: - Sniper Elite: Classics Collection
expires_today.long_description:
Feel the exhilaration of lining up the perfect shot with the Sniper Elite: Classics Collection. Choose from dozens of rifles, maps, and targets across 5 complete Sniper Elite titles—including Sniper Elite 5 and Sniper Elite 4 Deluxe. Relive sweet shots with the awesome Kill Cam and immerse yourself in the strategic gameplay. Pay what you want for hours of in-depth gunplay from the ultimate shooting simulation experience, and help support Special Effect with your purchase.

Keys expire. Please redeem and activate on Steam before April 6th, 2027.

expires_today.title: Animate Like a Pro with Moho PRO
expires_today.description: Elite animations for professionals and digital artists
expires_today.long_description: Animate like a pro—MOHO Pro 12.5 offers powerful rigging tools or 2D projects, assistance on frame-by-frame animation, dynamic particles and physics effects, and so much more! Optimized for a variety of animation styles, this collection features full Adobe Illustrator and SVG compatibility and improved drawing tools that transform your beautiful ideas into meaningful contributions to your projects. Don’t wait, Humble members who purchase this bundle receive a $125 credit towards an upgrade to MOHO Pro 14! Pay what you want for amazing creation tools, and help support Child’s Play Charity with your purchase!

expires_today.title: The All-Inclusive Codex, Claude Code & Python Automation Bundle
expires_today.description: Welcome to your all-inclusive Claude Coding resort!
expires_today.long_description:
Add the latest coding skills to your toolbelt with an all‑inclusive collection of Codex, Claude coding, and Python automation courses. Claude is an automated coding agent you can use to help create original code, check your work, and save yourself from spending countless hours overworking. Pay what you want for specialized lessons by Zenva like Intro to Agentic Coding with Claude Code and Intro to Agentic Coding with Codex to assist your mainline Claude coding learning journey. Harness the ultra‑powerful techniques of this amazing bundle and help support Alzheimer’s Research UK with your purchase.

Keys Expire. Please redeem before September 23, 2027.

expires_today.title: Ultimate Fantasy Miniatures Bundle
expires_today.long_description: Print your own fantastic fantasy miniatures and busts from anywhere with a gigantic bundle of designs to fit your preferred fantasy motifs! Spice up your personal collection with 100+ fresh creations to style, customize, and collect that perfectly enhance any game or TTRPG adventure! Cause a ruckus with the 8‑pack Ruins Mega Pack, the 10‑piece Lumberyard Set, alongside menacing orcs, mythical phoenixes, human warriors, modular tavern sets, weaponry, and so much more. Plus, a portion of your purchase helps support Make‑A‑Wish!

expires_tomorrow.title: SkullForge Studios Arsenal Mega Bundle
expires_tomorrow.long_description: Pay what you want for the ultimate collection of Arsenal printable minis for any occasion or the hit tabletop skirmish game by SkullForge Studios! This action-packed game pits fireteams of badass mercenaries against each other for contract payouts and glory. Each fireteam plays 5 drop troopers and 1 mega mech known as MCVs. Our Mega Bundle assembles hundreds of unique playables from terrain to vanguards like Arsenal Terrain: Mech Bay and Crew and Arsenal Fireteam: Zeta. Dominate the combat zone alongside your friends and help support the World Wildlife Fund with your purchase!

expires_tomorrow.title: 50 Essential Fantagraphics Titles by Fantagraphics
expires_tomorrow.long_description: A classic alien invasion thriller! An iconic Sunday strip adventure! A murder investigation with a pulpy twist! When it comes to publishing great comics, Fantagraphics knows what’s up, and if you’ve been looking to get into what this fantastic publisher has to offer, we’ve collected 50 of Fantagraphics’ best titles in one bundle! Solve the murder of a mysterious woman alongside a horror-obsessed 10-year-old in My Favorite Thing Is Monsters! Escape to an era of medieval swordfights and epic adventures with the first two collected volumes of Prince Valiant! Fight back against a devastating alien invasion in the subversive Argentine masterwork The Eternaut! All of these and many more are featured in this bundle of 50—yes, F-I-F-T-Y—of Fantagraphics’ best titles, so grab them now at the price of your choosing, and support the Freedom of the Press Foundation with your purchase!

expires_tomorrow.title: Voice Vault: The ultimate collection of human-made voice lines
expires_tomorrow.description: Unlock premium spoken lines with Voice Vault
expires_tomorrow.long_description:
Get everything you need to create authentic, engaging characters who resonate with your players with Voice Vault: The Ultimate Collection of Human‑made Voice Lines. Choose from 100+ human voice recordings with over 600 professionally recorded lines from professional voices like Bryce Garland, D’laina Hunt, Hannah Weeks, Ntlanhla Kutu, and more. Pay what you want for subscription‑ and royalty‑free audio packs from the industry’s biggest and boldest voices, and help support Children’s Miracle Network with your purchase!

Codes are redeemable through the Ovani website.

expires_tomorrow.title: Assemble Entertainment Cozy Games Collection
expires_tomorrow.description: Cozy up to great games this fall
expires_tomorrow.long_description:
Presenting the Assemble Entertainment Cozy Games Collection! Play A Juggler’s Tale, the critically acclaimed puppet adventure, or experience the joy of running your own cozy small business by creating your own stickers in Sticky Business! Choose from adorable designs for your stickers, cutely pack orders, and build deep friendships with your customers. This warm ’n’ fuzzy bundle also includes the Book of Shadows, Seaside Tales, and Camp Zinnias DLC!

Keys expire. Please redeem and activate on Steam before April 7th, 2027.

expires_tomorrow.title: Indies in Space
expires_tomorrow.long_description:
Journey to the stars and beyond in this bundle of indie games that take outer space to the next level! Run your own lunar colony mining resources and navigating Earth-Moon politics in The Crust! Do your part waging war against the nefarious Bugs in co-op first-person-shooter Starship Troopers: Extermination and real-time strategy game Starship Troopers: Terran Command! Seek your fortune and battle your enemies in this bundle of space indies! Grab all of these and more at the price of your choice, and support Spaceship Earth charity with your purchase!

Keys expire. Please redeem and activate on Steam before April 7th, 2027.

expires_tomorrow.title: The Best of C.J. Cherryh by Daw Books
expires_tomorrow.long_description: Traverse planets, galaxies, and whole universes of adventure and mystery in this bundle of award-winning author C.J. Cherryh’s best novels! Start with her Hugo Award-winning sci-fi novel Downbelow Station, set on a backwater planet and its space station caught in the middle of an intergalactic war! Dive into the author’s classic (and extensive) space opera series full of assassination, mystery, and interspecies intrigue with Foreigner 10th Anniversary Edition! Take her high fantasy classics for a spin with all four books of The Complete Morgaine, following a woman tasked with saving the very fabric of reality from an ancient network of portals! There’s so much more to explore in this bundle of 30+ sci-fi and fantasy ebooks from one of the greatest working authors of our time, so grab them now at the price of your choice and support BINC with your purchase!

expires_tomorrow.title: Back to School Linux, Red Hat, Kubernetes and Cybersecurity Certification Bundle with Practice Exams
expires_tomorrow.long_description:
Looking for a little extra credit to start the semester? Unlock an expert‑led selection of back‑to‑school learning courses on Linux, Kubernetes, Red Hat hacking, and cybersecurity from the gurus at Mammoth Club! expires_tomorrow.title: Meshingun All-Stars
expires_tomorrow.long_description:
Discover the Meshingun All-Stars Bundle, bringing together some of Meshingun’s biggest hits and best-selling Mega Packs in one massive collection. Get thousands of high-quality, production-ready assets covering horror, apocalyptic, abandoned, historical, Feudal Japan, World War themes, and more. Whether you’re building your next game, cinematic, or environment, this bundle gives you a huge range of assets to create more while saving serious production time. Professional License included.

Keys expire. Please redeem your keys before September 24th, 2027.

expires_tomorrow.title: CRPG Pack: Isometric Immersion
expires_tomorrow.long_description:
Isometric games—that is, games that use a little projection trick to make the map look 3-D—give players a whole new way to move their characters around a world. Because we love celebrating unique perspectives, we’ve collected our favorite isometric games in one convenient bundle! Gather your crew, board your voidship, and travel through uncharted regions of space in Warhammer 40,000: Rogue Trader! Take on a world infested with demons and develop powers of mythic proportions in the Game of the Year Edition of Pathfinder: Wrath of the Righteous! Try to solve a murder while also trying to uncover your own past in the groundbreaking detective RPG Disco Elysium - The Final Cut! More fantastic adventures and unforgettable stories await you in this bundle of isometric classics, so grab them now at the price of your choice, and support Little Free Library with your purchase!

Keys expire. Please redeem before March 23rd, 2027
